The '''Mark 6''' was a combat [[Sensor/Legends|scanner]] produced by [[Chedak Communications]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and sold for 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It had the functions of a general purpose scanner, and added mapping and navigation capability, data storage and secured communications.<ref name="DC" />
